h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shahjahanpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shahjahanpur

items.pText: Ask a colony committee in Shahjahanpur what they want in a playground and the reply is often a slide and a swing. The more useful question is who will play there. A toddler, a six-year-old and an eleven-year-old need very different equipment. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment for every one of these age groups at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,180 km away.

Shahjahanpur is a cantonment city in the Rohilkhand region of Uttar Pradesh, with hot summers and foggy winters. We supply schools, colonies and gardens in the city and the district, and deliver by road. Tell us the size of your site and roughly how many children of each age live nearby. We will suggest equipment for each group and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

items.a: Low, simple pieces such as spring riders, toddler swings and 3 ft slides. They let very young children play with little help, and a parent can stand close by.

items.q: Can one play area serve toddlers and older children together?
items.a: Yes, if it is zoned. Keep the toddler pieces in their own corner and place larger equipment for older children further away, with a clear walkway between them.
Yes. We send the equipment by road from our Vasai factory and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India.
